proposal: Out-of-fold expert stack: SVM height specialist + C + multi-prototype distances; local affine XY
selection: Meta balanced cost wrong + 0.35*abstain; select on outer training records only.
limitations: All existing datasets have already been inspected; nested splits prevent direct fit/tuning leakage but cannot turn this into a fresh prospective test.
0mm and 3mm are separate acquisition campaigns; height and campaign are confounded.
No intermediate heights, new poses, new devices, or continuous contact transitions are measured.
Generated predictions and models belong in ignored reports; reproducible code, plan, result documentation and selected experimental model are preserved separately.
previousCandidate: D1 kernel ridge did not simultaneously improve correct/wrong/abstain; preserved separately.
exploratoryRevision: After inspecting D1 and conservative D2 cross-pass outputs, fixed SVM decision margin at 0.2 to avoid excessive abstention. This is retrospective development; new row/paired splits do not constitute an untouched prospective test.
metaInputs: SVM score, clipped C log-odds, per-height prototype residuals, predicted XY and interactions; no true XY, height or row inputs.
metaTraining: Three whole-row folds produce out-of-fold expert features. Meta family/regularization selected by grouped CV on those features. Outer rows/passes excluded from all stages. Inner meta CV is a selection heuristic, not an unbiased test because base experts were cross-fitted once. All outer evaluation is retrospective.
